payload.question: Did the council build what it said it would build?
payload.label: Building programme delivered, 2021/22
payload.council_caveat: The budget here is the revised in-year figure, which is the fair basis for judging delivery but is a target the council had already re-set once during the year. Money not spent mostly rolls forward rather than being lost.
payload.evidence: The council approved a building programme of £67.007m for 2021/22 and spent £33.585m of it — 50%. Both figures are in the capital table in that year's accounts.
